name: My Team FC - R4
description: Round 4: possession-by-carry. Root cause of the 81% loose-ball matches was that every pass leaves the ball at 12+ m/s while a free ball is only collectable below 5 m/s, so no pass could ever be collected. R4 carries the ball forward by default, only passes to a receiver already within collectable range with a clear lane, aims loose-ball chasers at the point where the ball finally slows, and drives forward from kickoff.
